description: Canonical metadata for a game leaderboard, published in the game's own AT Protocol repository.

main.description: Defines one leaderboard offered by a game. Supports simple single-integer arcade/speedrun boards (`scoreFormat` + `sortOrder`), local multi-component schemas (`#points`, `#percentage`, `#time`, `#enum`, `#text`), parameterized sub-board `dimensions` (modes, input methods, speedrun variables, characters), peak vs live Elo `rankingMode`, bounded event/jam windows (`startsAt` / `endsAt`), localized `translations`, `rankedVersions`, and `trustedIssuers`.

game.description: AT-URI of the game definition record (e.g. `games.atmosphere.define`) in the publisher's repository.

name.description: Display name of the leaderboard (e.g. `High Scores`, `Fastest Clear`, `Freedom Dive [FOUR DIMENSIONS]`).

description.description: Optional explanation of what this leaderboard tracks and any rules.

translations.description: Optional localized `name` and `description` strings keyed by BCP-47 language tag (e.g. `ja`, `ja-Latn`, `ko`).

icon.description: Required square icon or jacket art representing this leaderboard (512x512 PNG or WebP recommended).

iconAlt.description: Accessibility alt text for the leaderboard icon.

sortOrder.description: Primary ranking direction for single-metric boards (`largerIsBetter` for points/Elo; `smallerIsBetter` for speedruns).

rankingMode.description: Controls how AppViews pick each player's active standing: `best` ranks by their peak historical metric; `latest` ranks by their most recent `recordedAt` entry (for fluctuating Elo/Glicko-2 MMR ladders or active win-streaks).

scoreFormat.description: Formatting rules for single-value integer scores (`numeric`, `time`, or `currency`). Optional when `components` defines structured multi-component columns.

components.description: Optional dictionary map of component key (`record-key`, e.g. `ex-score`, `accuracy`, `lamp`, `clear-time`) to local typed component definition (`#points`, `#percentage`, `#time`, `#enum`, `#text`). Forward-compatible with the proposed Lexicon `map` type.

componentOrder.description: Optional explicit display order of component keys in `components` (e.g. `["ex-score", "accuracy", "lamp", "clear-time"]`). Preserves author-intended column order across DAG-CBOR canonical map-key sorting.

defaultComponent.description: Key in `components` used as the default ranking column when `components` is present.

dimensions.description: Optional dictionary map of filterable sub-board category variables (e.g. `mode`, `inputMethod`, `character`, `rules`, `seeded`) avoiding combinatorial leaderboard proliferation.

dimensionOrder.description: Optional explicit display order of dimension keys in `dimensions`.

detailsSchema.description: Optional Lexicon `$type` or NSID hint indicating the structured breakdown object expected in `leaderboard.score#details` (e.g. `games.opengaming.defs#judgmentBreakdown` or a genre-specific lexicon).

rankedVersions.description: Optional list of leaderboard-legal chart, map, or game-build hashes/identifiers (e.g. MD5/SHA-256 hex digest of a chart file). When non-empty, active rankings filter out scores whose `version` is not in `rankedVersions`—preserving pre-patch runs in player PDSs without revoking them as cheated.

trustedIssuers.description: Optional list of additional DIDs authorized to sign score attestations for this leaderboard (e.g. federated tournament hosts or post-EoS community revival instances).

timeframes.description: Which leaderboard time windows this game tracks and displays for this board (`daily`, `weekly`, `monthly`, `allTime`).

startsAt.description: Optional opening timestamp for bounded Game Jam contests, weekend tournaments, or seasonal ladders.

endsAt.description: Optional closing cutoff timestamp for bounded Game Jam contests, weekend tournaments, or seasonal ladders.

recordPolicy.description: Client PDS write cadence: `overwriteBest` overwrites a single deterministic `rkey` (minimal PDS footprint, zero history); `personalBests` appends a new record whenever the player sets a PB on any sortable component (retaining superseded runs in PDS for `includeObsolete`); `perWindowBest` writes at most one PB per beat in `timeframes`; `everyRun` logs every completed run.

scoreMin.description: Optional minimum valid raw headline score.

scoreMax.description: Optional maximum valid raw headline score.

listOrder.description: Optional sort index controlling the display order among a game's leaderboards.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this leaderboard definition was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when this leaderboard definition was last updated.

points.description: Defines an integer points/count component on a multi-component leaderboard (e.g. EX Score, Points, Collectibles, Max Combo).

percentage.description: Defines a fixed-point percentage accuracy/completion component. Values are stored as integers scaled by `10^precision` (e.g. `precision: 2` and value `9942` displays as `99.42%`).

precision.description: Number of decimal places implied on the integer value.

maximum.description: Maximum valid scaled integer value (e.g. `10000` for `100.00%`, or `10100` for `101.00%`).

time.description: Defines an elapsed-time or survival-time component on a multi-component leaderboard.

enum.description: Defines an ordered categorical component such as rhythm-game clear lamps (`ALL PERFECT`, `FULL COMBO`, `CLEAR`) or letter grades (`S`, `A`, `B`, `C`).

sortOrder.description: By default (`smallerIsBetter`), earlier entries in `values` (index 0) rank higher.

text.description: Defines a display-only text metadata component (e.g. build summary or modifier string).

componentMap.description: Dictionary map of component key (`record-key` format, 1..32 chars, e.g. `ex-score`, `accuracy`, `lamp`, `clear-time`) to local typed component definition (`#points`, `#percentage`, `#time`, `#enum`, `#text`). Uses the forward-compatible `$keyFormat`/`$valueType` Lexicon `map` convention.

$keyFormat.description: Placeholder schema hint for future Lexicon `map` key validation (never written in records).

$valueType.description: Placeholder schema hint for future Lexicon `map` value validation (never written in records).

dimension.description: Defines a filterable sub-board category variable (such as rhythm `mode` or `inputMethod`, speedrun `category` or `character`, or roguelike `stake`).

name.description: Human-readable label for this dimension (e.g. `Mode`, `Input Method`, `Character`, `Ruleset`).

values.description: Allowed option tokens (`id` + `name`). When omitted or `allowCustomValues: true`, arbitrary string tokens (`<= 256` chars) are accepted.

required.description: When `true`, every score submitted to this leaderboard must include a value for this dimension key.

allowCustomValues.description: When `true`, scores may supply values outside the predefined `values` list (useful for modded characters or open seeds).

defaultValue.description: Optional default option `id` pre-selected when viewing rankings without an explicit filter.

dimensionMap.description: Dictionary map of dimension key (`record-key` format, 1..32 chars, e.g. `mode`, `inputMethod`, `character`) to `#dimension` definition.

$keyFormat.description: Placeholder schema hint for future Lexicon `map` key validation (never written in records).

$valueType.description: Placeholder schema hint for future Lexicon `map` value validation (never written in records).
